correctness.rationale: For any smooth complex hyperelliptic genus g>=3 curve and general degree g+4 L with balanced pi_*L=O(1)⊕O(2), the complete series embeds into the smooth cubic scroll S=P(pi_*L)⊂P4. On S, C~2H+(g-2)f, hence normal N_(C/S)=L²A^(g-2), first line of degree 4g+4. The cubic scroll normal resolution 0→O_S(2f)→O_S(H+f)^3→N_(S/P4)→0, restricted to C and divided by LA, identifies quotient with M_D^*, D=LA^-1 and pi_*D=O⊕O(1). Comparison of the two complete evaluation sequences yields 0→A^-1→M_D→AD^-1→0. Its dual and re-twist give saturated second line L²A^-1 and quotient LA² in N_S|C. The normal-sequence inverse image gives E2, and quotient degrees (4g+4,2g+6,g+8) are strictly decreasing since the gaps are 2g-2 and g-2 for every g>=3. Line bundles are stable and inclusions have locally free quotients, so this is the unique HN filtration. The determinant L^5A^(g-1) has adjunction degree 7g+18. Independently checked scroll c1=3H+f, its restricted degree 3g+14, all three HN degree equalities and exact gaps for g=3..24. These tests check arithmetic/determinant constraints, not sheaf exactness; the actual exact normal and evaluation diagrams supply the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The exact target is the complete three-slope Harder–Narasimhan filtration for general embedded hyperelliptic genus g>=3 in P4, not merely instability of the normal bundle. Liu 2026 explicitly proves the scroll destabilizing line for general embeddings and supplies a two-step scroll-core profile in Lemma 4.1 only for r>=g+2; for P4 the normalized rank is r=3<g+2. The basic scroll/evaluation mechanism is known and credited, but its eligible higher-rank result does not imply an HN three-line filtration with grades (4g+4,2g+6,g+8) for this excluded range. Coskun–Jovinelly–Larson treats the genus-two sextic P4 separately, not g>=3 hyperelliptic locus. Mathematically motivated low-dimensional HN extension survives the precise hypothesis comparison; the ease of recovering it from standard sequences remains historical-equivalence risk.
residual_risks: The cubic-scroll normal resolution is classical and could lead to an implicit earlier all-genus low-rank HN calculation not indexed under the same wording.
The result assumes a general L with balanced direct image; special L and non-hyperelliptic curves are not covered.
The degree checker verifies arithmetic only, not exactness or saturation of vector-bundle maps.

value.rationale: The complete HN polygon of a natural exceptional curve locus describes precise instability, not just the previously known yes/no failure of semistability. The canonical rank-two step and all three line-quotient degrees for every genus g>=3 in P4 are natural algebraic-geometric invariants a researcher comparing normal bundles could require; no general ambient-dimension or paper-sized theorem is needed.

limitations: Complex smooth hyperelliptic g>=3, general complete degree-(g+4) polarization with balanced pushforward, ambient P4 only.
Quotient extensions need not split; no Hilbert scheme or special-polarization claim.
